meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会多出一个微信渠道:启动时用手机扫码登录个人微信,把新收到的微信消息绑定到助手组后,Claude 才能回复私聊和群聊;按设置,陌生人来消息可先弹审批卡,批准后才回复。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入个人微信渠道时运行此技能;安装并扫码登录后,绑定账号一收到微信消息,Claude 就会参与处理。

say.text: 把刚收到的微信私聊接到助手组
微信来陌生人消息,先发审批卡再回复
群聊消息用共享会话处理
say.note: 保持默认 shared 模式,群内共享同一会话

howto.what_en: Adds a WeChat channel to NanoClaw using Tencent's official iLink Bot API. After a QR-code login, Claude can receive and reply to WeChat DMs and group chats. A wiring step is needed before it responds. Unknown senders can be gated.
howto.when_en: When you want to connect a personal WeChat account to NanoClaw. It takes effect after WECHAT_ENABLED=true, a restart, and a successful QR scan; Claude then handles incoming WeChat messages.

say_en.text: Wire the latest WeChat DM to the default agent group.
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm to bind the unwired messaging group.

say_en.text: Ask for approval before replying to unknown WeChat senders.
say_en.note: Sets the sender policy to request_approval.

say_en.text: Use a shared session for group chat messages.
say_en.note: Keeps the default shared session mode per group.
